WITH heir AS ( SELECT id, shared_with_id FROM project_shares WHERE project_id = $1 AND shared_with_type = 'user' AND permission = 'editor' AND shared_with_id <> $2 ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 1 ), moved AS ( UPDATE projects SET owner_id = (SELECT shared_with_id FROM heir), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 AND owner_id = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM heir) RETURNING owner_id ), dropped AS ( DELETE FROM project_shares WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM heir) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moved) ) SELECT owner_id FROM moved
